def transform(grid):
    """Compare aligned cells on either side of the zero divider."""
    separator = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == 0 for row in grid))
    left = [row[:separator] for row in grid]
    right = [row[separator + 1:] for row in grid]
    common = set(value for row in left for value in row) & set(value for row in right for value in row)
    fill = min(common)
    return [[3 if a == b else fill for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)] for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]
